result.rule: No verified receipt means zero result. PR, deploy, listing, monitoring, self-access, and test activity are progress only.
reasons: Progress exists, but it does not satisfy the selected real-world result contract.
result.next_verification_action: Record the concrete risk before, changed state after, and how it was verified.

a2a_interaction.truth_boundary: The auditor accepted caller-supplied markers and explicitly refused to count them as a result. It did not fetch or cryptographically verify an Agent Guild artifact.

payment_boundary.selector_observation: An initial malformed request mentioned the paid skill only to forbid it and received HTTP 402. The challenge was not followed. A corrected request using only the exact free skill schema returned HTTP 200.

agent_guild_product_feedback.gap: Agent Guild reported no A2A protocol and a 404 Agent Card even though the endpoint-path-relative Agent Card was publicly readable and the same endpoint completed a valid A2A message/send task moments later.
agent_guild_product_feedback.cause: The current bounded probe checks only the origin-root /.well-known/agent-card.json rather than also checking the declared endpoint path plus /.well-known/agent-card.json. Its payment check also risks treating a mixed free/paid card as though the free endpoint itself must challenge.
agent_guild_product_feedback.accepted_adaptation: Probe endpoint-relative and root Agent Card paths over the same SSRF-screened pinned host, report the exact card path used, keep reachability and preflight evidence consistent, and never fail a mixed free/paid card merely because its free operation does not return 402.

conversion_reason: The pre-existing IP402 machine performed a useful free audit of a real Agent Guild result, but it only classified caller-supplied evidence and did not independently fetch or verify AG. This is machine interaction and product feedback, not a strict community conversion.
